title: Test-file header documents `node --test scripts/js-tests/`, which fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on Node 22 — the wired glob form is the only working path
evidence:
// Unit tests for server/priv/static/form_stepper.js — run with
// `node --test scripts/js-tests/` (wired into `make test` as test-js).
detail: On the repo's Node (v22.22.0; CI setup-node "22") a directory arg is executed as a test file: `node --test scripts/js-tests/` fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND, 0 tests run (verified, even on a trivial dir with clean env). Only the Makefile's glob form works (52/52 pass via make test-js). Same stale line pre-exists in apply_analytics.test.js.
recommended_fix: Point the header at the wired command (`node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js` or `make test-js`) in both js-tests files.

title: deferred-work.md entry's interim mitigation is wrong for per-file-only preflight blocks — no aggregate banner exists there, so the stepper hold is completely silent
detail: showBanner runs only on an aggregate breach; a per-file-only violation (one >5MB file under the 22MB aggregate) takes clearBanner() + setSubmitDisabled(anyPerFile) — no banner. The stepper's preflight hold then finds no [data-testid="documents-section-error"] to scroll to, so the applicant is held on the step with zero visible message until the deferred fix ships.
recommended_fix: Correct the entry's mitigation sentence (banner covers aggregate breaches only, per-file holds are silent); consider pulling the one-line form.js display:flex fix into this PR instead of deferring.
